sources.EN16931: The CEN EN 16931 CII Schematron (EN16931-CII-validation): 1.3.12 in the Mustang CLI 2.14.0, 1.3.16 in the KoSIT XRechnung configuration 2026-08-31.
sources.CII: The rules of the CII syntax binding (CII-SR-*, CII-DT-*) of the same Schematron.
sources.FACTUR-X: The Factur-X 1.0.07 (ZUGFeRD 2.3) Schematron of the profile, in the Mustang CLI 2.14.0.
sources.XRECHNUNG: The XRechnung 3.0 CII Schematron: in the Mustang CLI 2.14.0, and 3.0.2 in the KoSIT XRechnung configuration 2026-08-31.
sources.PEPPOL: The PEPPOL rules of the XRechnung CII Schematron.
sources.IP: A rule of invoice-pro: the official rules accept the XML, but the invoice would be wrong, e.g. required by law or a value would be lost.

BR-02.summary: An invoice has an invoice number (BT-1).

BR-03.summary: An invoice has an invoice date (BT-2) that is a calendar date.

BR-05.summary: An invoice has an invoice currency code (BT-5).

BR-CL-04.summary: The invoice currency code (BT-5) is in the ISO 4217 code list of the validation of the profile: Factur-X alone in MINIMUM and BASIC WL (FX-SCH-A-000040), both versions of the EN 16931 code list (1.3.12 of Mustang, 1.3.16 of KoSIT) in XRechnung, and all of them in BASIC and EN 16931, where a code only the Factur-X list lacks is FX-SCH-A-000040. A currency the newest EN 16931 list has withdrawn (e.g. BGN) is allowed in BASIC and EN 16931, whose Factur-X validation accepts it, with a warning (IP-CODE-01).
BR-CL-04.note: The field is `locale` when the currency comes from the locale. A code only the newest EN 16931 code list has is named as such.

IP-TAX-01.summary: `tax: none` in an e-invoice: the items would be declared as zero rated (`Z`). Use `tax.zero()`, `tax.exempt(grounds: ..)`, `tax.outside-scope()` or `tax-exempt-small-biz`.
IP-TAX-01.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 8 UStG; Art. 226 No. 9 and 11 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC (the rate, or the reason why no VAT is charged)

IP-PRINT-02.summary: Amounts printed in another currency than the invoice currency (BT-5), e.g. a custom locale that prints "zł" while the XML states EUR.

IP-DOC-01.summary: A subject that names another kind of document than an invoice (e.g. "Gutschrift", "Angebot", "Credit note", "Devis") without `document-type`: the e-invoice would state a commercial invoice that asks the buyer to pay. See [Document Type](#9-document-type-bt-3).

BR-DE-17.summary: XRechnung allows the document types 326, 380, 381, 384, 389, 875, 876 and 877 (BT-3). XRechnung only warns, but validators such as Mustang reject the invoice, so it is an error.

IP-DOC-05.summary: A `preceding-invoice-date` without `preceding-invoice-nr`: the e-invoice states a preceding invoice (BG-3) by its number (BT-25), so its date (BT-26) would be lost.

BR-DE-26.summary: A corrected invoice (BT-3 = 384) names the invoice it corrects (BG-3). XRechnung only warns, but validators such as Mustang reject the invoice, so it is an error.

IP-DOC-02.summary: A corrected invoice (`document-type: "corrected"`) without `preceding-invoice-nr`: it replaces an invoice, which the VAT Directive (Art. 219) requires it to name. XRechnung checks it as `BR-DE-26`.

IP-DOC-03.summary: A credit note with a negative total: it states the credited amounts as positive amounts, so it would ask the buyer to pay.

IP-DOC-04.summary: An invoice with a negative total: valid, but a credit note (`document-type: "credit-note"`) is the document for a credit.

IP-PROFILE-01.summary: An input the profile cannot state, e.g. the buyer trading name (BT-45) in `"basic"`, or `notes`, a `payee` or the method of `paid` in `"minimum"`: the invoice may print it, but it is not written into the e-invoice. The hint names the lowest profile that states it.

BR-CL-08.summary: The subject code of a note (BT-21) is a code of UNTDID 4451; BASIC WL checks the same list as FX-SCH-A-000162.

IP-PERIOD-01.summary: A printed service period that is not the one the XML states: another date, or a text of its own where the XML states the invoice date. A text of its own besides dated items or a `service-period` is a warning. See [Service Period](#10-service-period-bt-72--bg-14).
IP-PERIOD-01.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 6 UStG; Art. 226 No. 7 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC (the date of the supply)

BR-DE-TMP-32.summary: An invoice states the date of the supply (BT-72) or the invoicing period (BG-14). Information in the XRechnung Schematron, a warning of invoice-pro: a credit note or a prepayment invoice without dates states none.

IP-PERIOD-03.summary: The printed invoice does not show the date of the supply, which German law requires on every invoice but a small-amount invoice; for a seller elsewhere a warning where it is not the invoice date. See [Printed Details](#printed-details).
IP-PERIOD-03.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 6 UStG, UStAE 14.5 Abs. 16, § 33 UStDV; Art. 226 No. 7 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

IP-KEY-01.summary: A key of `sender`, `recipient`, `delivery-address`, `sender.tax-representative` or `payee` that `invoice-pro` does not know: its value is not written into the e-invoice.

IP-KEY-02.summary: A misspelled key the e-invoice reads, or another name of it (e.g. `vatId`, `vat_id`, `ustid`, `uid`, `e-mail`, `siret` or `zip`): its value would be missing without notice.

BR-09.summary: The seller postal address has a country code (BT-40).
BR-09.note: A safety net: an address without `country` gets the country of the locale.

BR-11.summary: The buyer postal address has a country code (BT-55).
BR-11.note: A safety net: an address without `country` gets the country of the locale.

BR-57.summary: The deliver-to address has a country code (BT-80).
BR-57.note: A safety net: an address without `country` gets the country of the locale.

BR-20.summary: The postal address of the seller tax representative has a country code (BT-69).
BR-20.note: A safety net: an address without `country` gets the country of the locale.

BR-CL-14.summary: A country code of an address is in the ISO 3166-1 code list of the validation of the profile: Factur-X alone in MINIMUM and BASIC WL (FX-SCH-A-000036), which has South Sudan (SS); both versions of EN 16931 in XRechnung, which have the Netherlands Antilles (AN); all of them in BASIC and EN 16931, where a code only the Factur-X list lacks is FX-SCH-A-000036.

IP-COUNTRY-01.summary: A party without `country` whose VAT identifier was issued by another country: the country of the locale would be written (e.g. "DE" for the Austrian VAT ID "ATU12345678"). Set `country` on the party, also for a foreign VAT registration.

IP-ADDR-01.summary: A city line with a number of three or more digits, but no post code in the format of the party's country (e.g. "1012 Amsterdam" instead of "1012 AB Amsterdam"): the post code would be missing, and the number would be written into the city name.

BR-CO-09.summary: A VAT identifier starts with the prefix of a country ("EL" for Greece).

BR-CO-26.summary: The seller is identified by an identifier (BT-29), a legal registration identifier (BT-30) or a VAT identifier (BT-31); in MINIMUM by BT-30 or BT-31.

IP-PRINT-03.summary: The XML states the seller's VAT identifier (BT-31) or tax number (BT-32), one of which the law requires on the invoice, but the printed invoice shows neither. See [Printed Details](#printed-details).
IP-PRINT-03.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 2 UStG, § 33 UStDV; Art. 226 No. 3 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

IP-ID-01.summary: An identifier of the [`id` module](./api-reference/invoice/identifiers.md) whose format or check digit is wrong, e.g. a SIRET with a typo. `id.custom(..)` takes an identifier unchecked.

IP-ID-03.summary: An identifier given for a field it does not belong to: a Leitweg-ID as party identifier or legal registration identifier, another identifier as `leitweg-id`, a GLN or D-U-N-S number as `legal-id`, or a register number as `id`.

BR-CL-11.summary: The scheme of a legal registration identifier (BT-30, BT-47, BT-61) is an ISO/IEC 6523 code of every validation of the profile (FX-SCH-A-000031 in MINIMUM and BASIC WL).

vat-outside-scope.summary: An invoice not subject to VAT (O) states no VAT identifiers, so it names no seller tax representative (BG-11) with a VAT identifier (BT-63): by where the category occurs, on a line (BR-O-02), a document level allowance (BR-O-03) or charge (BR-O-04).

IP-TAX-05.summary: A seller tax representative (BG-11) with a VAT identifier on an invoice not subject to VAT (`O`) in `"basic-wl"`: EN 16931 excludes that identifier for items not subject to VAT (`BR-O-02`), which the validation of the profile does not check, as it states no lines.

BR-18.summary: The seller tax representative has a name (BT-62).

BR-56.summary: The seller tax representative has a VAT identifier (BT-63).

IP-VAT-226.summary: An intra-community supply (`K`) or a cross-border reverse charge (`AE`) without the buyer VAT identifier (Art. 226 No. 4 VAT Directive), which the official rules miss: in BASIC WL (no invoice lines) and with a buyer `legal-id`; a tax representative without address (No. 15).
IP-VAT-226.legal: Art. 226 No. 4 and No. 15 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

BR-17.summary: The payee (BG-10) has a name (BT-59), and is someone other than the seller.
BR-17.note: BASIC WL checks the name only: its Factur-X rule compares the payee with a path of the seller that never matches, so invoice-pro reports a payee that is the seller as IP-PAY-05 there.

IP-PAY-05.summary: A `payee` that is the seller (its name, identifier or legal registration identifier) in `"basic-wl"`: the payee (BG-10) is someone other than the seller (`BR-17`), which the validation of the profile does not check.

IP-ID-02.summary: Two values for one party identifier, of which only one can be written: a `global-id` without scheme next to `id`, a `location-id` next to `id` of the delivery address, or two identifiers with scheme.

BR-CL-10.summary: The scheme of a global identifier of the seller, the buyer or the payee is an ISO/IEC 6523 code of every validation of the profile (FX-SCH-A-000031 in BASIC WL).

BR-CL-26.summary: The scheme of the global identifier of the deliver-to location (BT-71) is an ISO/IEC 6523 code of every validation of the profile (FX-SCH-A-000031 in BASIC WL).

CII-SR-450.summary: The buyer has one identifier (BT-46): `ram:ID` or `ram:GlobalID`.

CII-SR-449.summary: The deliver-to location has one identifier (BT-71): `ram:ID` or `ram:GlobalID`.

CII-SR-451.summary: The payee has one identifier (BT-60): `ram:ID` or `ram:GlobalID`.

PEPPOL-EN16931-R020.summary: The seller has an electronic address (BT-34), which XRechnung requires.

PEPPOL-EN16931-R010.summary: The buyer has an electronic address (BT-49), which XRechnung requires.

IP-EADDR-01.summary: An EN 16931 invoice without the electronic address of the seller (BT-34) or the buyer (BT-49): EN 16931 leaves them optional, but a delivery over Peppol requires them, which XRechnung checks as `PEPPOL-EN16931-R020` and `R010`.

BR-62.summary: The seller electronic address (BT-34) has a scheme identifier.

BR-63.summary: The buyer electronic address (BT-49) has a scheme identifier.

BR-CL-25.summary: The scheme of an electronic address (BT-34, BT-49) is in the CEF EAS code list of the validation of the profile: XRechnung accepts the schemes 0219 and 0220, which the Factur-X list lacks (FX-SCH-A-000031 in the other profiles). The withdrawn scheme 9901 is rejected in every profile (IP-CODE-01 in BASIC WL and BASIC).

BR-DE-5.summary: XRechnung requires the name of the seller contact (BT-41).

BR-DE-6.summary: XRechnung requires the phone number of the seller contact (BT-42).

BR-DE-7.summary: XRechnung requires the email address of the seller contact (BT-43).

BR-DE-27.summary: The phone number of the seller contact (BT-42) has at least three digits. XRechnung only warns (and KoSIT accepts it), but validators such as Mustang reject the invoice, so it is an error (maintainer decision).

BR-DE-28.summary: The email address of the seller contact (BT-43) matches XR-EMAIL-REGEX of the XRechnung Schematron. XRechnung only warns (and KoSIT accepts it), but validators such as Mustang reject the invoice, so it is an error (maintainer decision).

BR-DE-4.summary: XRechnung requires the seller post code (BT-38).

BR-DE-9.summary: XRechnung requires the buyer post code (BT-53).

BR-DE-11.summary: XRechnung requires the deliver-to post code (BT-78).

BR-DE-15.summary: XRechnung requires the buyer reference (BT-10), e.g. the Leitweg-ID.

vat-buyer-id.summary: An intra-community supply (K) states the buyer VAT identifier (BT-48), a reverse charge (AE) it or the buyer legal registration identifier (BT-47), where the category occurs: on an invoice line (BR-IC-02, BR-AE-02), a document level allowance (-03) or charge (-04).

BR-IC-12.summary: An intra-community supply (K) states the deliver-to country (BT-80).
BR-IC-12.note: A safety net: without a delivery address, the model states the buyer's country as the deliver-to country.

IP-VAT-138.summary: An intra-community supply (`K`) that does not go to another member state: a deliver-to country (BT-80) that is the seller's own country (or, for a seller without VAT identifier of its own, the country of its tax representative), or a buyer VAT identifier not issued by an EU member state (or "XI" for Northern Ireland).

BR-16.summary: An invoice has at least one invoice line (BG-25).

BR-25.summary: Every invoice line has an item name (BT-153).

BR-CL-23.summary: The unit code of an invoice line (BT-130) is a UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code.

IP-UNIT-01.summary: A unit code used verbatim that is also a common German abbreviation of another unit (`STK`, `PAL`, `FL`, `GL`, `KT`).

IP-UNIT-02.summary: A unit given as text that invoice-pro does not know (e.g. "Nacht"): the e-invoice would state it as "one" (`C62`), a guess the validators accept. Give the unit with its code, e.g. `(display: "Nacht", code: "C62")`.

BR-CO-04.summary: Every invoice line has a VAT category (BT-151).
BR-CO-04.note: A safety net: every item has a VAT category (`tax: none` is written as zero rated, IP-TAX-01).

BR-30.summary: The period of an invoice line (BG-26) does not end before it starts.

PEPPOL-EN16931-R110.summary: The start of the period of an invoice line (BT-134) is within the invoicing period (BG-14).

PEPPOL-EN16931-R111.summary: The end of the period of an invoice line (BT-135) is within the invoicing period (BG-14).

IP-PERIOD-02.summary: The date of an item outside the `service-period` of the invoice. XRechnung checks it for an invoicing period (BG-14) as `PEPPOL-EN16931-R110` and `R111`. See [Item Notes, Periods and Country of Origin](#12-item-notes-periods-and-country-of-origin).

BR-CL-15.summary: The country of origin of an item (BT-159) is in the ISO 3166-1 code list of the validation of the profile: a code only the Factur-X list lacks (e.g. AN) is FX-SCH-A-000026 in EN 16931 and accepted in XRechnung.

BR-CO-18.summary: An invoice has at least one VAT breakdown (BG-23).
BR-CO-18.note: Only BASIC WL, which has no invoice lines: in the profiles with lines, an invoice without VAT breakdown has no lines, which BR-16 reports.

BR-48.summary: Every VAT breakdown (BG-23) has a VAT category rate (BT-119), except one not subject to VAT (O). The write guard checks the XML for it as well; this names the VAT group.

IP-DEC-01.summary: A VAT rate with more than 4 decimals, which the XML cannot state exactly (and which could collide with another VAT group).

BR-CL-18.summary: The VAT category code is one EN 16931 allows: S, Z, E, AE, K, G, O, L or M, or the split payment of Italy (B, see BR-B-01 and BR-B-02), which only XRechnung accepts: the Factur-X profiles reject it as FX-SCH-A-000179, as the code list of Factur-X lacks it.

vat-rate-positive.summary: The standard rate (S), IGIC (L) and IPSI (M) have a rate above 0 where they occur: on invoice lines (BR-S-05), document level allowances (-06) and charges (-07).
vat-rate-positive.note: Follows CEN 1.3.12 for IPSI (M), whose rate must be above 0; CEN 1.3.16 accepts 0.

vat-rate-zero.summary: Zero rated (Z), exempt (E), reverse charge (AE), intra-community (K) and export (G) items have the rate 0 where they occur: on invoice lines (BR-Z-05), document level allowances (-06) and charges (-07), in BASIC WL in the VAT breakdown (-09).

BR-O-09.summary: Items not subject to VAT (O) carry no VAT, so they have no rate.

BR-E-10.summary: Exempt items (E) have a VAT exemption reason (BT-120) or code (BT-121).

BR-CL-22.summary: A VAT exemption reason code (BT-121) is in the VATEX code list of every validation of the profile (FX-SCH-A-000181 in BASIC WL).

IP-TAX-02.summary: A VAT exemption reason code (BT-121, `code` of the `tax` module) of another VAT category, e.g. `"VATEX-EU-IC"` on an exemption (`E`), or on a taxed category (`S`, `Z`, `L`, `M`). See [Tax Category Codes](#3-tax-category-codes).

IP-TAX-03.summary: Items of one VAT category and rate with different exemption reason codes: EN 16931 states one code per VAT group, so the reasons are stated as text (BT-120) only.

IP-TAX-04.summary: An exemption (`E`) with an exemption reason code but without `grounds`: the printed invoice must state why no VAT is charged (§ 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 8 UStG, Art. 226 No. 11 of the VAT Directive).
IP-TAX-04.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 8 UStG; Art. 226 No. 11 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

vat-seller-id.summary: Taxed categories (S, Z, E, AE, L, M) need the seller VAT identifier (BT-31), its tax number (BT-32) or the VAT identifier of its tax representative (BT-63), where they occur: on invoice lines (BR-S-02), document level allowances (-03) or charges (-04).

vat-seller-vat-id.summary: An intra-community supply (K) and an export (G) need the seller VAT identifier (BT-31) or the VAT identifier of its tax representative (BT-63), where they occur: on invoice lines (BR-IC-02, BR-G-02), document level allowances (-03) or charges (-04).

BR-IC-11.summary: An intra-community supply (K) states the date of the supply (BT-72) or the invoicing period (BG-14).

BR-O-11.summary: Items not subject to VAT (O) are not combined with other VAT categories on one invoice.

BR-B-01.summary: An invoice with the split payment of Italy (B) is a domestic Italian invoice: every address it states is in Italy. Only XRechnung accepts the category; BASIC and EN 16931 reject it as FX-SCH-A-000179 as well.

BR-B-02.summary: An invoice with the split payment of Italy (B) has no standard rated (S) items, allowances or charges.

BR-DE-18.summary: The payment terms (BT-20) write every cash discount in the Skonto syntax of XRechnung, on a line of its own that a line break follows, and its base amount with 2 decimals.

BR-CO-25.summary: An invoice with an amount due (BT-115) has a payment due date (BT-9) or payment terms (BT-20).

BR-DE-23-b.summary: XRechnung forbids the details of a direct debit (BG-19) next to a credit transfer (BG-17). An invoice states one payment means (BT-81): a credit transfer, a direct debit, a payment card or one other means, so that the buyer knows how to pay and does not pay twice.

BR-DE-24-b.summary: XRechnung forbids the details of a direct debit (BG-19) next to a payment card (BG-18). An invoice states one payment means (BT-81): a credit transfer, a direct debit, a payment card or one other means, so that the buyer knows how to pay and does not pay twice.

CII-SR-467.summary: All payment means of an invoice have the same payment means code (BT-81).
CII-SR-467.note: A rule of CEN 1.3.16 (KoSIT) only; BASIC WL and BASIC report two kinds of payment means as IP-PAY-03.

IP-PAY-03.summary: Two kinds of payment means in `"basic-wl"` or `"basic"`, whose validation accepts them together, e.g. `bank-details` next to `card-payment`: an invoice states one payment means (BT-81), so that the buyer does not pay twice. The other profiles report them as `CII-SR-467` (or `BR-DE-23-b`, `BR-DE-24-b`).

BR-DE-23-a.summary: A credit transfer (BT-81 = 30, 58) states the account it is paid to (BT-84).

CII-SR-470.summary: A credit transfer (BT-81 = 30, 58) names the account it is paid to by its IBAN or a proprietary identifier (BT-84).
CII-SR-470.note: A rule of CEN 1.3.16 (KoSIT) only. XRechnung reports the missing account as BR-DE-23-a, BASIC WL and BASIC as IP-PAY-04.

IP-PAY-04.summary: A credit transfer (`paid(method: "transfer")`, or `bank-details` without IBAN) without the account the buyer pays to (BT-84), which EN 16931 requires (`BR-61`); the Factur-X rules of `"basic-wl"` and `"basic"` test another account, so their validation accepts it.

BR-DE-19.summary: The IBAN of a SEPA credit transfer (BT-84) has valid check digits.

BR-DE-20.summary: The IBAN of the debited account of a SEPA direct debit (BT-91) has valid check digits.

IP-PAY-01.summary: An IBAN with wrong check digits or format in `bank-details` or as `debtor-iban` of `direct-debit`, where `BR-DE-19` and `BR-DE-20` do not check it (outside XRechnung, or an invoice not in euro).

BR-DE-25-a.summary: A SEPA direct debit (BT-81 = 59) states the direct debit (BG-19).

PEPPOL-EN16931-R061.summary: A direct debit states its mandate reference (BT-89).

BR-DE-30.summary: XRechnung requires the creditor identifier (BT-90) of a direct debit.
BR-DE-30.note: A safety net: `direct-debit` requires the creditor identifier.

BR-DE-31.summary: XRechnung requires the debited account (BT-91) of a direct debit.

BR-DE-24-a.summary: A card payment (BT-81 = 48, 54, 55) states the payment card (BG-18).

BR-CL-16.summary: The payment means code (BT-81) is in the UNTDID 4461 code list (FX-SCH-A-000023 in BASIC WL).

IP-PAY-02.summary: A SEPA creditor identifier (BT-90) of `direct-debit` with wrong check digits or format.

IP-PREPAID-01.summary: Prepayments (BT-113) above the invoice total, so that the amount due (BT-115) is negative: valid, but most likely not intended.

IP-DEC-02.summary: An amount with more than 2 decimals, e.g. of a currency such as KWD (reported for `currency`) or of a locale that rounds money more finely: the XML states amounts with 2 decimals (`BR-DEC-*`), so it would state another amount than the invoice prints, and the amounts would no longer add up.

IP-CODE-01.summary: A code that the newest EN 16931 code list (1.3.16) has withdrawn, which the Factur-X validation of the profile still accepts, but a validator with the current list rejects, as KoSIT does: a currency such as BGN or HRK (replaced by the euro) is allowed with a warning in BASIC and EN 16931 (in XRechnung it is `BR-CL-04`); the electronic address scheme 9901 is an error in BASIC WL and BASIC (in EN 16931 and XRechnung `BR-CL-25`).

IP-PRINT-01.field: item <id> (<name>), discount (<name>), surcharge (<name>), tax <category> <rate> or line-items
IP-PRINT-01.summary: An amount or quantity of the XML differs from the printed one: of a line, an allowance or charge, a VAT group or a total; with gross prices, a net amount plus VAT differs from the printed gross amount by more than the rounding allows. A failure is a bug of invoice-pro.
IP-PRINT-01.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 5, 7 and 8 UStG; Art. 226 No. 6 and 8 to 10 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; the XML of a hybrid invoice (ZUGFeRD, Factur-X) states the invoice its PDF shows

BR-CO-17.summary: The VAT amount of a VAT group (BT-117) is its taxable amount (BT-116) times its rate (BT-119), within the tolerance of 1 the validators allow. A failure is a bug of invoice-pro.

vat-basis.summary: The net amounts of the lines and the allowances and charges of a VAT group add up to its taxable amount (BT-116, BR-S-08 and the like). A failure is a bug of invoice-pro.

IP-CALC-01.summary: The parts of an allowance or charge per VAT category (BG-20, BG-21) do not add up to its printed amount. A failure is a bug of invoice-pro.
IP-CALC-01.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 7 UStG; Art. 226 No. 8 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC (the taxable amount per rate, with its reductions)

IP-CALC-02.summary: The printed lines, allowances and charges of a VAT category do not add up to its printed taxable amount (with gross prices: its gross total). A failure is a bug of invoice-pro.
IP-CALC-02.legal: § 14 Abs. 4 Satz 1 Nr. 7 and 8 UStG; Art. 226 No. 8 and 10 of the VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

PEPPOL-EN16931-R120.summary: The line net amount (BT-131) is the invoiced quantity (BT-129) times the net price (BT-146) per price base quantity (BT-149) plus the line's charges (BT-141) minus its allowances (BT-136), within 0.02 (0.5 for HUF).
PEPPOL-EN16931-R120.note: KoSIT reports the rule as a warning; Mustang 2.14 does not check it. The net prices of gross prices keep enough decimals for it (logic/net-amounts.typ); a line total rounded more coarsely than its price, e.g. in a currency without decimals or with a money rounding of the locale to 0.05, can break it.

IP-GUARD-00.field: the input the XML element is written from
IP-GUARD-00.summary: Summarizes the guard's findings next to errors of the validator.
IP-GUARD-00.note: A rule of the XML write guard (src/zugferd/guard/report.typ), which builds its messages.

IP-GUARD-01.field: the input the XML element is written from
IP-GUARD-01.summary: An element the profile's schema does not know at its position, or text where it expects elements.
IP-GUARD-01.note: A rule of the XML write guard (src/zugferd/guard/report.typ), which builds its messages.

IP-GUARD-02.field: the input the XML element is written from
IP-GUARD-02.summary: An element out of the order of the schema.
IP-GUARD-02.note: A rule of the XML write guard (src/zugferd/guard/report.typ), which builds its messages.

IP-GUARD-03.field: the input the XML element is written from
IP-GUARD-03.summary: An element more often than the schema or the Schematron allows.
IP-GUARD-03.note: A rule of the XML write guard (src/zugferd/guard/report.typ), which builds its messages.

IP-GUARD-04.field: the input the XML element is written from
IP-GUARD-04.summary: A required element that is missing or has no text.
